title: To designate the arboretum at the Hunter Holmes McGuire VA Medical Center in Richmond, Virginia, as the "Phyllis E. Galanti Arboretum".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The expanded summary of the House passed version is repeated here.)

(Sec. 2) This bill designates the arboretum at the Hunter Holmes McGuire VA Medical Center in Richmond, Virginia, as the Phyllis E. Galanti Arboretum.

summary.headline: Names the arboretum at a Richmond, Virginia VA medical center after Phyllis E. Galanti.
summary.what_it_does: This law officially names the arboretum at the Hunter Holmes McGuire VA Medical Center in Richmond, Virginia, the Phyllis E. Galanti Arboretum. It is an honorary designation and does not change how the arboretum or the medical center operates.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 18, 2015.
